name: npm/mongodb-mcp-server
title: MongoDB
description: Query and explore MongoDB in read-only mode: databases, collections, schema inspection, and Atlas-compatible connections.

toolsSummary.name: find / aggregate
toolsSummary.description: Query collections with filters, projections, and aggregation pipelines (read-only deployment).

toolsSummary.name: schema
toolsSummary.description: Inspect databases, collections, and inferred document shapes.

toolsSummary.name: connect
toolsSummary.description: Use a connection string (including Atlas) with optional TLS material via environment variables.

io.sami/gallery.about: Official MongoDB MCP server for exploring data and metadata with a read-only default; connects via standard URI and supports TLS options through env vars.

environmentVariables.name: MDB_MCP_TLS_CERTIFICATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to client TLS key file.

environmentVariables.name: MDB_MCP_TLS_CERTIFICATE_CA_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to CA bundle for TLS verification.
